process: High-speed air impingement (direct-fired forced convection) bread-baking oven, energy model (Sect. 3.5)
measure: Design oven for optimum convective heat transfer coefficient (35 W/m2 K)
note: Uses an extra 2.9 kJ/kg of fan electricity to save 44.7 kJ/kg of heat losses to ambient; on top of the 10% saving from optimisation for temperature uniformity (Khatir et al. 2012b, ref. [15]).
UK 4,484 t CO2e/yr; worldwide 75,530 t CO2e/yr; based on 2.8 billion kg/yr UK bread.
